use parser_subset::{
    Edition, LexedStr, SyntaxKind,
    parser::{self, Event, Fragment, Input, Output},
};
mod corpus;

fn mix(hash: &mut u64, value: u64) {
    *hash = hash.rotate_left(9) ^ value;
    *hash = hash.wrapping_mul(0x9e3779b185ebca87);
}

fn bytes(hash: &mut u64, value: &str) {
    mix(hash, value.len() as u64);
    for byte in value.bytes() {
        mix(hash, byte as u64);
    }
}

fn output(hash: &mut u64, input: &Input, output: Output, parents: &mut usize) -> usize {
    let mut consumed = 0;
    mix(hash, output.events.len() as u64);
    for (index, event) in output.events.iter().enumerate() {
        match *event {
            Event::Start {
                kind,
                forward_parent,
            } => {
                mix(hash, 1);
                mix(hash, kind as u64);
                if let Some(offset) = forward_parent {
                    *parents += 1;
                    let target = index + offset.get() as usize;
                    assert!(target > index && target < output.events.len());
                    assert!(matches!(output.events[target], Event::Start { .. }));
                    mix(hash, offset.get() as u64);
                } else {
                    mix(hash, 0);
                }
            }
            Event::Finish => mix(hash, 2),
            Event::Token { kind, n_raw_tokens } => {
                mix(hash, 3);
                mix(hash, kind as u64);
                mix(hash, n_raw_tokens as u64);
                assert!(n_raw_tokens > 0);
                consumed += n_raw_tokens as usize;
            }
            Event::Error { index } => {
                assert!((index as usize) < output.errors.len());
                mix(hash, 4);
                mix(hash, index as u64);
            }
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(consumed, input.len());
    // Replay the forward-parent chains as the production tree builder does.
    let mut events = output.events;
    let mut depth = 0usize;
    for index in 0..events.len() {
        let event = std::mem::replace(&mut events[index], Event::Finish);
        match event {
            Event::Start {
                kind,
                forward_parent,
            } => {
                if kind != SyntaxKind::TOMBSTONE {
                    depth += 1;
                }
                let mut parent = forward_parent;
                let mut at = index;
                while let Some(offset) = parent {
                    at += offset.get() as usize;
                    match std::mem::replace(
                        &mut events[at],
                        Event::Start {
                            kind: SyntaxKind::TOMBSTONE,
                            forward_parent: None,
                        },
                    ) {
                        Event::Start {
                            kind,
                            forward_parent,
                        } => {
                            if kind != SyntaxKind::TOMBSTONE {
                                depth += 1;
                            }
                            parent = forward_parent;
                        }
                        _ => panic!("forward parent must start a node"),
                    }
                }
            }
            Event::Finish => {
                assert!(depth > 0);
                depth -= 1;
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(depth, 0);
    for error in &output.errors {
        bytes(hash, error);
    }
    output.errors.len()
}

fn source(hash: &mut u64, text: &str, edition: Edition, parents: &mut usize, trace: bool) -> usize {
    let lexed = LexedStr::with_edition(text, edition);
    for error in lexed.errors() {
        mix(hash, error.token as u64);
        bytes(hash, &error.message);
    }
    let input = Input::from_lexed(&lexed);
    for index in 0..=input.len() {
        mix(hash, input.kind(index) as u64);
        mix(hash, input.is_joint(index) as u64);
    }
    let parsed = parser::parse_source_file(&input);
    if trace {
        println!(
            "lex-errors={:?} events={:?} errors={:?}",
            lexed.errors(),
            parsed.events,
            parsed.errors
        );
    }
    lexed.errors().len() + output(hash, &input, parsed, parents)
}

fn main() {
    let mut hash = 0;
    let mut parents = 0;
    let mut prefixes = 0;
    for &(name, text, expect_errors) in corpus::FILES {
        for edition in [Edition::E2021, Edition::E2024] {
            let errors = source(&mut hash, text, edition, &mut parents, true);
            assert_eq!(errors > 0, expect_errors);
            for (end, _) in text.char_indices() {
                source(&mut hash, &text[..end], edition, &mut parents, false);
                prefixes += 1;
            }
        }
        println!("file={} hash={}", name, hash);
    }
    for (fragment, text, valid) in [
        (Fragment::Expr, "#[allow(unused)] a + b * c << 2", true),
        (
            Fragment::Expr,
            "match x { Some(ref mut y) if *y > 0 => y.foo::<Vec<u8>>(), _ => 0 }",
            true,
        ),
        (Fragment::Expr, "foo::<A<B<C>>>(x).field[1] += 2", true),
        (Fragment::Pat, "Some(x @ 1..=9) | None", true),
        (Fragment::PatParam, "Some(ref mut x)", true),
        (Fragment::Type, "&'a mut [Option<Result<u8, E>>]", true),
        (Fragment::Path, "crate::a::B<C<D>>", true),
        (Fragment::Block, "{ let x = 1; x + 2 }", true),
        (Fragment::Stmt, "let (a, b) = pair()", true),
        (Fragment::Item, "fn f<T: Clone>(v: T) -> T { v }", true),
        (Fragment::Vis, "pub(in crate::inner)", true),
        (Fragment::Lifetime, "'a", true),
        (Fragment::Literal, "-123", true),
        (Fragment::Meta, "allow(unused)", true),
        (Fragment::Items, "fn f() {} struct S;", true),
        (Fragment::Stmts, "let x = 1; x + 2", true),
        (Fragment::Expr, "a +", false),
        (Fragment::Pat, "Some(", false),
        (Fragment::Type, "Vec<", false),
        (Fragment::Expr, "a b", false),
    ] {
        let lexed = LexedStr::new(text);
        let input = Input::from_lexed(&lexed);
        let parsed = parser::parse_expansion(&input, fragment);
        assert_eq!(parsed.errors.is_empty(), valid);
        println!("events={:?} errors={:?}", parsed.events, parsed.errors);
        output(&mut hash, &input, parsed, &mut parents);
        // Items and Stmts are expansion-only aggregate fragments.
        if fragment != Fragment::Items && fragment != Fragment::Stmts {
            for start in 0..=input.len() {
                let result = parser::fragment_or_error(&input, start, fragment);
                assert_eq!(parser::fragment_len(&input, start, fragment), result.ok());
                match result {
                    Ok(len) => {
                        mix(&mut hash, 5);
                        mix(&mut hash, len as u64);
                    }
                    Err(at) => {
                        mix(&mut hash, 6);
                        mix(&mut hash, at as u64);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        println!("fragment={:?} hash={}", fragment, hash);
    }
    assert!(parents > 0);
    println!(
        "prefixes={} forward-parents={} hash={}",
        prefixes, parents, hash
    );
}
